notes: More accurate calorie targets. Gym sessions no longer count as being on your feet all day: tell the app about your normal day (or let your watch's steps decide), and pick a weekly pace for your cut or gain. Your target never drops below a safe floor for your body. Home shows one calorie card when something needs a look: a more accurate target, your real daily burn from 3 weeks of food and weight logs, a gentler pace when training dips on a cut, a fresh suggestion after a 2.5 kg change, or a nudge when your steps drop. Setup now asks about your body, normal day and pace, like the web app.
